synopsis: Thailand's best street food chefs face off against one another. With a life-changing cash prize and the chance of a professional career at stake, who will emerge as the ultimate winner under the guidance of experienced chefs?

episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.synopsis: The new season starts with a bang, as the street food vendors are unexpectedly thrown into cooking for 100 guests without any prep time.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.synopsis: The pressure is on as the contestants team up to create Thai street food dishes to impress the Spanish judges.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.synopsis: In this tricky challenge, contestants must find a way to get the most out of the ingredients provided – and leave nothing to waste.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.synopsis: The contestants do the heavy lifting when they cook for a group of bodybuilders — and their dishes must be nutritious in addition to being delicious.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.synopsis: Quiet chaos hits the kitchens as the chefs must guide their teams through service with one tricky rule: no shouting orders.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.synopsis: A crowd of university students floods the kitchen, challenging chefs to craft street food that's both delicious and irresistibly photo-worthy.

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.synopsis: The winners hold the power to put their rivals in a tricky spot for the next challenge. But can the losers beat the test and create delicious dishes?

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.synopsis: Using a fusion of Thai and Japanese cuisine, the competitors scramble to prepare in-flight meals for a plane bound for Tokyo. Can they deliver?

episodes.title: Episode 9
episodes.synopsis: The competition heats up as the contestants draw closer to the final leg. But to make the cut, they must display their skills to a new set of guests.

episodes.title: Episode 10
episodes.synopsis: The chefs step out of the kitchen and pair up with kids from SOS Children's Village to teach them cooking skills through tricky challenges.

episodes.title: Episode 11
episodes.synopsis: The semifinal pits the vendors against each other in a bidding war for ingredients, where cooking time is currency — and strategy decides who stays.

episodes.title: Episode 12
episodes.synopsis: In the final challenge, the vendors face three brutal solo tests with no head chefs and no help — just skill, grit and one shot at succeeding.
